sources.number_font: Official Nike Game jersey measured contours for all digits 0..9; see jersey_number_art. Blank home/away arm spans are skipped. Existing helmet/name blocks unchanged.

jersey_number_art.method: Full ten-digit family measured from official club-shop Nike Game jersey product fill contours. Each digit normalized to shared native height/baseline; source photo contour approximations are explicitly retained. Mesh/perforation speckles omitted below 400 source px area; colour and outline keys preserved. No marketing font used.

width_calibration.method: Trailing or centred single-digit primary photo controls replace foreshortened leading-digit widths; DEN6 uses explicit repeated77 template factor. Individual glyph widths are retained, not forced equal. All native heights/baselines/colours unchanged.

venue.notes: Bengals home games at Paycor Stadium (the retail Paul Brown Stadium record s06; one end-zone texture set serves both ends). End zones: the retail orange paint with black tiger stripes is kept (the Bengals' end-zone design) with the 2004 letters replaced by the 2021 BENGALS wordmark in black with a white outline and the 2026 orange (post-step cin_endzone.py). Midfield: the primary striped B logo (s06's midfield texture is 512x256; post-step center_full.py writes it at that size). The retail midfield leaping tiger was a 1997-2003 mark. Fan banner texts are 2026 players and common fan phrases (INFERRED fan content). signsA1 (2004 sponsors and NFL shield, league class) stays retail.
